fact: The Auditor General found the Civil Aviation Authority of Botswana had no back-up policy and no evidence of restore tests for the year to 31 March 2020, and management said its replication site had technical issues and off-site replication would be normalised by end of October.
title: Report of the Auditor General on the Accounts of the Botswana Government for the Financial Year Ended 31 March 2020
publisher: Office of the Auditor General, Republic of Botswana
